item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed the Department of Communities' investigation of allegations that staff accepted bribes for preferential public housing allocations.
item.support: The Commission referred the matter back to DoC to investigate but maintained active oversight

item.text: The Commission concluded that the investigation took too long, failed to pursue basic inquiries and relied on flawed reasoning.
item.support: The DoC investigation was unnecessarily protracted, disjointed and lacked basic investigative competence.

item.text: The Commission found that poor communication and recordkeeping also hindered the handling of the allegations.
item.support: DoC's poor communication, recordkeeping and investigative practices seriously inhibited the ability to properly address the allegations received on this occasion.

item.text: The Commission made no recommendations because the department had already introduced changes to its governance and integrity arrangements.
item.support: In view of this response, the Commission makes no recommendations.

item.quote: The DoC investigation was unnecessarily protracted, disjointed and lacked basic investigative competence.
In view of this response, the Commission makes no recommendations.
